big_case.notes: Pro se debtor's emergency application to stay a district judge from ruling on his bankruptcy appeal while a recusal-mandamus rehearing petition was pending in the Fourth Circuit; denied by the Chief Justice in eight days with no response, referral or writing. Private dispute, no doctrinal or public stakes.

leakage.notes: Forward cell, prediction written 2026-11-09, before the 2026-11-10 denial. Log is largely outcome_only (no result bodies, no legible document dates), so graded on queries: corpus lookups of neighbouring application numbers 26A654-26A662 including this applicant's companion 26A658, and CourtListener lookups of the Fourth Circuit mandamus docket 26-2406, related CA4/E.D. Va. dockets and four CA4 opinions dated July-October 2026. None targets this application's disposition, none reads qp-topics, and the reasoning cites no post-Nov-9 fact. Lower-court and companion material is legitimate forward signal.
